name: JG_TPD_ADJUSTMENTS_INT
description: This interface table contains imported data related to headers and lines of Payables and Receivables transactions and is used to override only the tax point date.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the legal entity.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area identifier for Payables or Receivables.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the business unit.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Payables or Receivables transaction line identifier.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Payables invoice number or Receivables transaction number.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Payables invoice line number or Receivables transaction line number.

columns.name: INV_HEADER_ADJUSTMENT_DATE
columns.description: New date to override the Payables or Receivables tax point date at header level.

columns.name: INV_LINE_ADJUSTMENT_DATE
columns.description: New date to override the Payables or Receivables tax point date at line level.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: Indicates the request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
